note: Mixpost Lite is a Laravel package, not an app. Frontend (Vue/Inertia/Vite) rebuilt from source, then installed into a fresh Laravel 12 host app (path repository, SQLite). The host gets a test-only /login route that logs in a seeded user (host-login-shim.php), so the checks run on the real Mixpost dashboard.
setup: cd "$DATA/host" && composer config repositories.mixpost '{"type":"path","url":"'"$SRC"'","options":{"symlink":true}}' && composer require 'inovector/mixpost:*@dev' --no-interaction --no-progress

cd "$DATA/host" && php artisan mixpost:publish-assets --force=1 && php artisan vendor:publish --tag=mixpost-config --force && php artisan vendor:publish --tag=mixpost-migrations && php artisan migrate --force
